purpose: Provide an agent-safe, deterministic procedure for bringing the platform up, staging backlog ingestion, verifying real GPU physics execution, and troubleshooting phantom-loop behavior.
non_destructive_rules: Never kill unrelated Python processes outside this repository command line scope.
Never delete input_configs content during routine resets.
Treat queue_runtime.db as disposable runtime state.
Always verify artifact freshness before declaring ingestion success.

quick_start.goal: Clean start and ingest backlog through UI with physical execution verification.
steps: Run stop sequence and process verification.
Reset queues and runtime SQLite files.
Run CUDA handshake and backlog extraction.
Stage and start backlog via UI.
Verify simulation_data receives new .h5 artifacts within 60 seconds.

preflight_reset: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { ./.venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1; $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force simulation_data, provenance_reports, input_configs, runtime_logs, pareto_snapshots, archive_runs | Out-Null; '[]' | Out-File -Encoding utf8NoBOM backlog_queue.json; '{}' | Out-File -Encoding utf8NoBOM backlog_queue.json.claims.json; '{}' | Out-File -Encoding utf8NoBOM backlog_queue.json.workers.json; '[]' | Out-File -Encoding utf8NoBOM result_queue.json; Write-Host 'Preflight complete.' }"
clean_environment.expected_cuda_result: GPU_COUNT must be >= 1. If 0 or exception, stop and repair CUDA/CuPy environment before launch.

validation: g:/quantule_mapper/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import json; d=json.load(open('backlog_queue.json','r',encoding='utf-8')); print('BACKLOG_COUNT', len(d)); print('FIRST_KEYS', sorted(d[0].keys())[:12] if d else [])"

stage_then_start: $stagePayload = @{ hunt_name='INGEST_2100'; generations=2100; batch_size=1; population_size=2100; seeds_per_candidate=1; n_grid=128; t_steps=1200; dt=0.005; origin='UI_CONTROL'; mode='backlog'; backlog_source='backlog_queue.json' } | ConvertTo-Json
$startPayload = @{ staged_path=$stageResp.staged_path; hunt_name='INGEST_2100'; origin='UI_CONTROL'; mode='backlog'; backlog_source='backlog_queue.json' } | ConvertTo-Json

artifact_pulse_check: Get-ChildItem simulation_data | Sort-Object LastWriteTime | Select-Object -Last 5 | Format-Table LastWriteTime, Length, Name -AutoSize
artifact_size_check: Get-ChildItem simulation_data -Filter '*.h5' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime | Select-Object -Last 1 LastWriteTime, Length, Name | Format-List
pass_criteria: New .h5 file timestamp appears within 60 seconds of run start.
Worker logs include 'Evolution complete in XX.XXs'.
dlq_count remains stable (preferably 0 during steady-state ingestion).

symptoms: SQLite counters increment but no new .h5 artifacts are created.
Worker process exists but no 'Evolution complete' log lines.
simulation_data newest artifact older than 60 seconds under active run.
recovery_sequence: Stage/start run again and re-check artifact pulse in 60 seconds.

operator_checklist: Confirm worker logs physical evolution completion.
Confirm fresh .h5 creation and meaningful file size.
Confirm telemetry queue depth drains over time.
